q: Jesus fed five thousand people with five barley loaves and ____ small fish. (P2)
explain: The miracle of the five loaves and two fish fed the multitude.
hint: Number of small fish in the miracle.

q: Jesus selected and appointed ____ disciples to be His core apostles. (P2)
explain: Jesus chose the twelve apostles to preach and heal.

q: The disciple who betrayed Jesus to the chief priests for thirty pieces of silver was ____. (P2)
explain: Judas Iscariot led the temple guards to arrest Jesus in Gethsemane.

q: Jesus rose from the dead on the ____ day after His crucifixion. (P2)
explain: Christ's resurrection occurred on the third day (Easter Sunday).
